envelope.description: Convert the issue and pr tools

body.title: Convert the issue and pr tools
body.summary: Convert the existing issue.ts and pr.ts tools to typebox input (JSON equal to the snapshot) and output schemas, ghExec with a limit key, ghApprovalClass and withGhFailureNet; legacy failure text stays in output and error; register the converted tools. gh_pr_diff keeps its behaviour in this task.
acceptanceChecks: each converted tool's input schema serialises identically to its snapshot row
each tool result validates against its output schema and existing result data keeps its shape
no call in issue.ts or pr.ts passes its own timeout

tests.name: gh-compat.test.ts: issue and pr tools' input schemas serialise identically to the snapshot
gh-output-schemas.test.ts: issue and pr tool results validate against their output schemas for success and failure
gh-timeouts.test.ts: no ghExec call in issue.ts or pr.ts passes its own timeout
